instruction: Run `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\rlc_bp.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\rlc_bp.out`, `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\rlc_bp_measure.txt`, and `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\rlc_bp.dat`. Then read the sampled dB measurements from `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\rlc_bp_measure.txt` and write `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\metrics.json` with `f0`, `Q`, and `BW_3dB`, where `f0` is the peak sample frequency and `BW_3dB` is the sample-grid width between the lowest and highest frequencies that stay within 3 dB of that peak.
source: PSpice native sampled AC sweep of a nonideal loaded resonant response
